correctness.rationale: Exact beta moments identify the Jacobi entries, rotation yields the numerical radius, and equation (1) is an exact nonnegative form decomposition. Uniform Taylor expansion in the \(N^{2/3}\) boundary layer, a global linear coercive potential bound, Dirichlet boundary penalty, bounded discrete gradients and tightness prove Mosco-type convergence of the smallest Rayleigh energy to \(\tfrac12(-\partial_x^2+px)\) on the half line. The first Airy zero yields the exact \(N^{-4/3}\) coefficient and uniqueness the positive \(L^2\) eigenfunction profile; 1922 finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof.

value.rationale: The numerical radius of polynomially truncated multiplication is a natural extremal quantity for the standard analytic Bergman scale. The sharp correction and degree-boundary Airy profile exhibit a nontrivial new \(N^{2/3}\) localization scale and p-dependent spectral constant, unlike the exact Hardy endpoint with \(N^{-2}\) behavior. Neither a trivial norm estimate nor a numerical finite-table value.
